note_en: 被 + (doer) + verb expresses the passive: (它)被用来形容…… "(it) is used to describe…"; 她被女儿笑了半天 "she was laughed at by her daughter for ages." The doer after 被 can be named or left out. In modern Chinese, 被 is used most often when something unpleasant or unexpected happens to the subject.
